news.title: Daily pass: 147 verified additions; old lead queue cleared
news.detail: Resolved the 4 leads left open on Nov 10 (Walraven & Reinhardt 1981 HERON shear-crack study, Bache 1981 DSP paper and Gutt 1972 aggregates-from-waste promoted; the 1974 BRE "Nibbler" demolition-equipment note rejected as off-topic). Discovery added 144 verified sources (R1477–R1623 overall range) focused on the thinnest topics — cellular/foamed and autoclaved aerated concrete, heavyweight/radiation-shielding concrete, mass concrete and RCC, oil-well/geothermal cements, expansive/rapid-hardening cements, lime/cement mortars and plaster, CEM II/III blast-furnace cements, shotcrete, natural pozzolans, failures/forensic case studies and cement-industry supply/emissions — plus a Portland-limestone cement backfill and a Sept–Nov 2026 current-awareness sweep (incl. ASTM C1697-26 and C926-26 catalogue records). 4 new leads rejected as duplicates/superseded editions. Mostly DOI/abstract-level, not full-text reviews.

change.entry: Daily pass 2026-11-11: 147 verified additions R1477–R1623 (3 promoted from the 4 previously open leads; 144 from new discovery). Nibbler lead rejected (off-topic). 4 newly found leads rejected (duplicate/superseded editions of R178, R828, R111 and an older BSI edition). No open leads remain. R1–R1476 preserved; topic membership union maintained.

gap: Daily pass 2026-11-11: candidate queue is empty (0 open). New additions are registry/catalogue-verified (48 abstract-level, 81 DOI metadata only, 14 catalogue records, 4 landing pages read) — not full-text reviewed. Citation chasing was not done this pass; thin topics remain cross-supply-region (regional cement/aggregate market data beyond emissions papers), RCC dam construction practice reports (USACE/USBR), and non-English national cement standards (JIS, GB, IS) — Japanese/Chinese standards bodies not reachable via Crossref.
